cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

mechanism: A acts as a practiced coffee host while treating B operational corrections as known procedure and offering B preference control to sustain help.
confusable: Unlike simple learning, each new clue must be claimed as familiar; unlike secure expertise A keeps B cooperative by yielding control of the process.
comparison: Hospitality with a machine differs from shared weather pressure and tent assembly.
seedUse: Use D42-a steam/flap/dial clues and S02-b adaptation to participant preference, without inheriting seed approval.
